editorial.why_this_event_stands_out: The BMW BERLIN-MARATHON is one of the most important marathons in the world. It combines World Marathon Major status, an exceptionally fast course, international elite fields, huge participation numbers and one of the most iconic finish areas in running. Berlin matters because marathon history has been rewritten here repeatedly, including world-record performances and landmark elite races.
editorial.course_character: The course is flat, broad, fast and built for personal bests. It runs through central Berlin and balances performance conditions with large-city marathon energy. For ambitious road runners, Berlin is one of the strongest marathon choices in the world for attacking a new PB.
editorial.atmosphere: International, loud, professionally organized and very large. The event has a clear World-Major feel with many spectators, many nations and a high sporting level.
editorial.good_fit_for: Runners chasing personal bests, fast road runners, World Marathon Major collectors, ambitious marathon debutants and athletes who want a large international city-marathon experience.
editorial.not_ideal_for: Runners looking for a small family-style event, trail character, spontaneous registration or a quiet course. The lottery and high demand also make the event harder to plan without a guaranteed entry route.
editorial.insider_tips: Collect race materials early at the Expo, book accommodation early, use public transport, check your start wave and pacer options in advance, bring throwaway clothing for the start wait and test hydration before race day.
